item.text:
`get_relevant_context` now does a symbolic BM25 search over records, not a class-only lookup: it calls `entity_index.search_records()` against the topic using `rdfs:label` weighted 2x and `description` weighted 1x, then ranks and returns the top-k matches. There is no absolute score floor; zero-term matches are excluded by the search itself, and the retrieval path stays purely symbolic with no LLM involvement.  
Sources: “get_relevant_context topic search: search_records (BM25 over label + description) replaces search_classes (label-only)”, “get_relevant_context: BM25 search_records replaces entity-index absolute floor for noise rejection”
